POP Series 1

Released September 1, 2004 · 17 cards

POP Series 1 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on September 1, 2004. It has 17 cards. It includes 17 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
